title: Star Applique
description: A cheerful five-pointed crochet star that can be sewn onto blankets, bags, or used as a tree ornament.
expectationText: A tiny project that introduces taller stitches like treble crochet. Whip up a handful in different colours for a garland, gift toppers, or festive decorations.

steps.title: Star point 1
steps.instruction: Into the ring: chain 3, then (yarn over twice, pull up a loop, pull through 2 twice) until 3 loops remain on hook, yarn over and pull through all 3. Chain 4. Slip stitch back into the ring.

steps.title: Repeat for all 5 points
steps.instruction: Repeat the star point sequence 4 more times so you have 5 points radiating from the centre ring.

steps.title: Tighten and finish
steps.instruction: Pull the magic ring closed tight. Fasten off and weave in the ends. Block the points with steam for crisp edges.

steps.title: Attach or display
steps.instruction: Sew the star onto a blanket corner or bag, or thread a loop through one point to hang as an ornament.
